title: Factor Out the Greatest Common Factor
description: Factor a polynomial by finding the greatest numerical and variable factor shared by every term, dividing each term, and checking that no common factor remains inside.

questions.stem_html: Which expression results from factoring the greatest common factor out of \(18x+30\)?
questions.explanation_html: The greatest common factor selected is \(6\). Divide every term by it to get \(3x+5\); multiplication recovers the original expression.

distractor_notes.A: Changes the last term’s sign during division.
distractor_notes.D: Doubles the outside coefficient without changing the inside.
